metadata.title: SEF Kopilot
metadata.description: Check an e-invoice before it goes to SEF: validation against SRB-CIUS, EN 16931 and Peppol, explanations that cite the law, and repairs you approve.

home.title: Check an <whole>e-invoice</whole> before you send it to SEF
home.tagline: SEF Kopilot checks a UBL invoice against <whole>SRB-CIUS</whole>, <whole>EN 16931</whole> and Peppol, explains every error with a citation from the law, and proposes repairs that you approve.
home.small: Open source under the Apache-2.0 licence, at the {status} stage.

preview.caption: An example: an invoice with type code 393 breaks rule SRB-001. The language model explains the rule, citing the specification, and proposes code 380; once approved, the validator finds the invoice valid.
preview.rule: The invoice type code (BT-3) is 380, 381, 383 or 386.
preview.explanation: 393 is not a code SEF accepts. A final invoice for goods and services delivered takes 380, a commercial invoice.
preview.citation: SRB-CIUS 1.3, Table 1, BT-3, in force from 6 June 2025.

route.title: The model suggests, the validator judges, you decide
route.intro: The language model stands between two deterministic walls: before it, the validator finds the errors; after it, the validator judges the changes the model proposed. Nothing gets through without a report free of errors.

validate.title: Validation
validate.text: The UBL 2.1 schema, the EN 16931 and Peppol Schematron rules, the SRB-CIUS rules written as code, and the arithmetic checked in Python. The same invoice always gets the same report.

explain.title: Explanation
explain.text: A language model writes, in Serbian or English, what the rule asks and why the invoice breaks it. It may cite only the passages of the law that retrieval returned, with the date they apply from.

repair.title: Proposed repair
repair.text: The model proposes changes as patches: where, what and why. Code applies them to a copy of the invoice, and the validator checks the copy again.

decide.title: Your decision
decide.text: The invoice does not change until you approve. The model cannot apply a change to an amount, VAT, a tax or company number or a date of supply: those are left to you.

standards.title: The rules it checks against
standards.intro: The official rule sets, unchanged, and the Serbian rules written from the specification. The model is no judge: their report is the verdict.
standards.ubl: The document's schema: its elements, their order and their types, as OASIS defines them.
standards.en16931: The business rules of the European standard for electronic invoices, in CEN's Schematron.
standards.srb: Serbia's use of the standard for SEF: its rules written as code from the official specification.
standards.peppol: The profile for exchange over the Peppol network, in OpenPeppol's Schematron.
standards.arithmeticText: Line totals, tax bases and VAT (BR-CO), added up in Python, never by the model.

developers.title: The same without the page: an HTTP API and MCP
developers.text: Every check is also an HTTP API, described by an OpenAPI document, and an MCP server at /mcp, for AI assistants and an ERP's own automation. An organization's owner issues the API keys.

closing.title: Try it on a made-up company
closing.text: The repository has synthetic invoices of made-up companies, valid ones and ones SEF would refuse. The public demo is for those: do not upload real invoices.

footer.notice: An independent open-source project. It is not a certified validator, and it is not affiliated with the Serbian Ministry of Finance or the SEF platform.

explanations.title: Explanations
explanations.intro: A language model can explain each rule: what it requires, why the invoice fails it and what to change, citing the regulations that apply on the invoice's issue date.
explanations.privacy: The model is sent each rule's message, which may quote a value of the invoice, and passages of the regulations; nothing is kept.
explanations.writing: The language model is writing the explanations. This may take up to half a minute…
explanations.written: Explained by the language model {model}, from the regulations as of {day}. Every citation is a passage the model was given.
explanations.unexplained: Not explained this time: {rules}. They will be once the rules above are fixed.
explanations.problem: This rule was not explained this time. Try again.

suggestion.privacy: The model is sent the violations, whose messages may quote values of the invoice, and the invoice's fields around them; nothing else of it.

decision.rejected: The repair is rejected, and the invoice stays as it was.
